data.name: Mqtt_PublishTopicWildcard
data.value: An MQTT publish topic (every topic except the receive topic) must not contain the wildcards '+' or '#', nor begin with '$share/' (a subscription-only prefix).

data.name: Mqtt_PublishTopicsMustDiffer
data.value: Every MQTT publish topic must be distinct — otherwise two Home Assistant entities would consume each other's payloads, or the retained state / availability would be corrupted.

data.name: Mqtt_PublishTopicUnderDiscoveryPrefix
data.value: No MQTT publish topic may live under the Home Assistant discovery prefix — that namespace is reserved for retained entity configuration, so publishing there would corrupt or delete a Home Assistant entity.

data.name: Mqtt_InvalidSubscriptionFilter
data.value: The MQTT receive topic is not a valid subscription filter: '+' must occupy a whole level and '#' must be the final whole level.

data.name: Mqtt_RxMatchesPublishTopic
data.value: The MQTT receive topic must not match any publish topic; otherwise the bridge would subscribe to its own output and replay bus frames in a loop.
